 League Cup news conferences: Alonso speaking; Man City rest five; Wirtz update
 0 Share Updated 2026년 10월 27일 화 오후 1:12 UTC Advertisement
 League Cup news conferences taking place before last 16 matches 
 Andoni Iraola and Xabi Alonso speaking with Liverpool and Chelsea facing each other on Wednesday in the standout clash
 Managers are expected to rest players for the matches; Enzo Maresca earlier confirmed that five key players have had three days off since the defeat at Aston Villa - while Iraola says there will 'definitely be changes' 
 Iraola also says he's 'optimistic' Florian Wirtz will be involved | Brighton have doubts over Andres & Kadioglu 
 There are two matches on Tuesday as Arsenal travel to League Two Fleetwood while Bradford face Peterborough
